html:
Malaysia is a federal monarchy in Southeast Asia, split by the South China Sea into the Malay Peninsula and the north of Borneo. The map uses the name from 1920, when the land was still British Malaya; the federation itself dates from 1963.

Britain took the land in steps. It held the Straits Settlements of Penang, Malacca and Singapore after the Anglo-Dutch Treaty of 1824, then made the Malay sultans its protected rulers. Under British rule Malaya became the world's leading source of tin and rubber, worked largely by migrants from China and India.

The main steps after that:

  • 1942 to 1945: Japanese occupation.
  • 1948 to 1960: the Malayan Emergency, a guerrilla war led by the Malayan Communist Party against British and Malayan forces.
  • 1957: the Federation of Malaya became independent.
  • 1963: Malaya joined Singapore, Sabah and Sarawak to form Malaysia; Brunei stayed out.
  • 1965: Singapore left the federation.

After race riots in 1969 the government's New Economic Policy favoured Malays in business and education. Under Mahathir Mohamad, prime minister from 1981 to 2003, Malaysia grew into an industrial exporter of electronics and palm oil.
sum: Malaysia is a federal monarchy in Southeast Asia, split by the South China Sea into the Malay Peninsula and the north of Borneo. The map uses the name from 1920, when the land was still British Malaya; the federation itself dates from 1963.
